interpretation: Two broad, smooth minima have median depths of 9.6 and 9.4 ppt. Spot or ellipsoidal variability and a half-period alias remain plausible. There is no securely identified eclipse.
prior_evidence: Earlier public TESS-SPOC full-frame threshold-crossing events

references.2023A&A...674A..15L: {\em Gaia} Data Release 3 The second {\em Gaia} catalogue of long-period variable candidates.

title: The SDSS-HET Survey of Kepler Eclipsing Binaries: Spectroscopic Dynamical Masses of the Kepler-16 Circumbinary Planet Hosts
